_comment: Titles and descriptions per item code. Edit freely — the script reads this file and falls back to the bare item code for anything missing. The spec table (diamond details, net weight by metal) is generated automatically and appended below the description, so don't repeat those numbers here.

The bolo mechanism means one bracelet fits any wrist, and it can be worn snug like a bangle or loose like a chain. Easy to put on one-handed, which matters more than it sounds.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds
  • Claw-set in a continuous front row
  • Sliding bead adjusts to any wrist size
  • Polished bead terminals
  • No clasp to fasten
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB206.title: 2 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Tennis Bracelet
AJLB206.description:
Description

Two carats of round brilliant lab-grown diamonds set in a four-claw line, each stone held individually so light passes through from every side. The links flex freely, letting the bracelet sit flat against the wrist.

The everyday tennis bracelet, kept deliberately fine. Slim enough to wear under a cuff or stacked with a watch, and substantial enough to wear on its own.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds
  • 2 CTW total diamond weight
  • Four-claw individual settings
  • Flexible link construction
  • Concealed box clasp with safety catch
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB221.title: 0.67 CTW Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Cuban Link Bracelet
AJLB221.description:
Description

A single emerald-cut lab-grown diamond sits east-west in a clean bezel at the centre of a fine cuban link chain. The step facets give a slower, glassier flash than a brilliant cut, and the bezel keeps the profile flat.

The chain does the work of a bracelet and the stone does the work of jewellery. Low enough to wear all day, and it slides under a sleeve without catching.

Key Features:

  • Emerald-cut lab-grown centre diamond
  • Bezel set east-west
  • Fine cuban link chain
  • Low, flat profile
  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB222.title: 0.75 CTW Oval Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Cuban Link Bracelet
AJLB222.description:
Description

A single oval-cut lab-grown diamond of three-quarters of a carat, set east-west at the centre of a fine cuban link chain. Laid sideways, the oval follows the line of the wrist rather than pointing along it.

The oval reads larger than its weight and softer than a round. Worn alone it is quiet; alongside the other chain bracelets in the family it holds its own.

Key Features:

  • Oval-cut lab-grown centre diamond, set east-west
  • 0.75 CTW total diamond weight
  • Fine cuban link chain
  • Low, flat profile
  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB223.title: 0.75 CTW Marquise Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Cuban Link Bracelet
AJLB223.description:
Description

One marquise-cut lab-grown diamond of three-quarters of a carat, set east-west at the centre of a fine cuban link chain so its long pointed outline runs with the wrist.

The marquise gives the widest spread of any shape at its weight, so a modest stone makes a clear statement. Easy to wear daily and to stack.

Key Features:

  • Marquise-cut lab-grown centre diamond, set east-west
  • 0.75 CTW total diamond weight
  • Fine cuban link chain
  • Low, flat profile
  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD243.title: 0.5 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Infinity Pendant Necklace
AJPD243.description:
Description

A single half-carat round brilliant lab-grown diamond sits in the lower loop of an infinity twist, held in four claws. The polished ribbon crosses above it and carries straight into the bail, so the pendant reads as one continuous line.

Small enough to wear under a collar and never take off, with a shape that carries its own meaning. The kind of piece bought for an anniversary and then worn daily.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown centre diamond
  • 0.5 CTW total diamond weight
  • Four-claw setting within an infinity loop
  • Polished ribbon twist
  • Integrated bail on a fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD278.title: 1 CTW Emerald & Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Toi et Moi Pendant Necklace
AJPD278.description:
Description

Two lab-grown diamonds sit side by side and slightly tilted — an emerald cut with its long step facets against a pear with its rounded brilliance. Each is claw-set individually so the two shapes stay distinct rather than merging into one.

Toi et moi means two stones for two people, and the appeal is in the contrast: one cut slow and glassy, the other bright. A carat in total, worn close to the collarbone.

Key Features:

  • Emerald-cut and pear-cut lab-grown diamonds
  • 1 CTW total diamond weight
  • Individually claw-set, set at an angle
  • Two-stone toi et moi arrangement
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD279.title: 2 CTW Pear & Radiant Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Toi et Moi Pendant Necklace
AJPD279.description:
Description

A pear-cut lab-grown diamond leans against a radiant cut, both claw-set and angled towards one another. The pear brings a soft curve, the radiant a clean rectangle with cropped corners — two carats of deliberate contrast.

The larger of our toi et moi pendants, and the one that reads clearly from across a room. Substantial without being heavy on the chain.

Key Features:

  • Pear-cut and radiant-cut lab-grown diamonds
  • 2 CTW total diamond weight
  • Individually claw-set, angled towards each other
  • Two-stone toi et moi arrangement
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD301.title: 5.46 CTW Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Pendant Necklace
AJPD301.description:
Description

A single large emerald-cut lab-grown diamond, claw-set at each corner, with a small crown of round brilliants arcing above it into the bail. The step facets give the long, clear flashes the cut is known for, and at this size there is plenty of room to see into the stone.

Our most substantial pendant. The round accents lift the eye towards the neckline without competing with the centre stone.

Key Features:

  • Emerald-cut lab-grown centre diamond
  • 5.46 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant accents above the centre stone
  • Four-claw corner setting
  • Tapered bail on a fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD352.title: 1 CTW Asscher Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Solitaire Pendant Necklace
AJPD352.description:
Description

A one-carat Asscher-cut lab-grown diamond, square with cropped corners and stepped facets that draw the eye straight down into the stone. Set alone beneath a plain tapered bail, with nothing else on the chain.

The most restrained pendant in the range, and the one that shows the cut best. Asscher is an architect's diamond — all symmetry and depth rather than scatter.

Key Features:

  • Asscher-cut lab-grown centre diamond
  • 1 CTW total diamond weight
  • Single-stone solitaire setting
  • Stepped facets with cropped corners
  • Plain tapered bail on a fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLR389.title: 1.27 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Three Stone Engagement Ring
AJLR389.description:
Description

A round brilliant lab-grown diamond flanked by two smaller rounds, all claw-set in a line, above a shank that splits into two pavé-set rows before meeting the centre.

The three stones are often read as past, present and future. The split shank lifts the setting clear of the finger and puts more light under the centre stone.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds
  • 1.27 CTW total diamond weight
  • Three stone claw setting
  • Split shank with pavé-set rows
  • Raised centre setting
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLR416.title: Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Milgrain Wave Band Ring
AJLR416.description:
Description

A flat band carved with a flowing wave pattern, with tiny round brilliant lab-grown diamonds flush-set along the crests so they sit level with the metal. Milgrain beading runs down both edges.

A quiet band with detail that rewards a close look. Comfortable enough to wear alongside an engagement ring or on its own.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, flush set
  • Carved wave pattern
  • Milgrain beaded edges
  • Flat profile with comfort fit
  • Wearable as a wedding or stacking band
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLR511.title: 2.25 CTW Cushion Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Engagement Ring
AJLR511.description:
Description

A cushion-cut lab-grown diamond ringed by a close halo of round brilliants that follows the stone's soft square outline, with small accents at each shoulder and a pavé-set band running most of the way round.

The halo does what a halo should — makes the centre stone read considerably larger without drawing attention to itself. Two and a quarter carats in total.

Key Features:

  • Cushion-cut lab-grown centre diamond
  • 2.25 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo
  • Accent stones at the shoulders
  • Pavé-set band
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLR559.title: 2.52 CTW Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Solitaire Engagement Ring
AJLR559.description:
Description

A pear-cut lab-grown diamond held in six claws, point upward, on a slim band pavé-set along the top half. Nothing surrounds the stone, so the full outline of the cut stays visible.

The pear elongates the finger and carries its weight well — two and a half carats that look every bit of it. A solitaire, with just enough on the band to catch light from below.

Key Features:

  • Pear-cut lab-grown centre diamond
  • 2.52 CTW total diamond weight
  • Six-claw solitaire setting
  • Pavé-set band
  • Elongating silhouette on the finger
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLR602.title: 1.12 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Double Row Band Ring
AJLR602.description:
Description

Two staggered rows of round brilliant lab-grown diamonds run across the face of this wide band, each stone in its own scalloped setting so the edge of the ring reads as a row of small arcs.

Wider and more substantial than a standard band, and enough on its own. The staggered rows keep the surface lively rather than regimented.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds
  • 1.12 CTW total diamond weight
  • Two staggered rows
  • Scalloped individual settings
  • Wide band profile
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJNT59.title: 1.09 CTW Oval Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Station Necklace
AJNT59.description:
Description

An oval-cut lab-grown diamond set east-west at the centre of a fine cable chain, with a small bezel-set round diamond stationed on either side.

Worn horizontally, the oval follows the line of the collarbone rather than pointing down it. The two stations add light without adding weight.

Key Features:

  • Oval-cut lab-grown centre diamond, set east-west
  • Two bezel-set round diamond stations
  • Fine cable chain
  • Low, flat profile
  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJNT64.title: 1.09 CTW Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Station Necklace
AJNT64.description:
Description

An emerald-cut lab-grown diamond claw-set east-west at the centre of a fine chain, with a bezel-set round diamond stationed to each side.

The step facets give a slower, glassier flash than a brilliant cut. Sitting sideways, the stone reads wider and sits flat against the skin.

Key Features:

  • Emerald-cut lab-grown centre diamond, set east-west
  • Two bezel-set round diamond stations
  • Fine cable chain
  • Low, flat profile
  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJNT68.description:

A single round brilliant lab-grown diamond enclosed in a smooth bezel, threaded directly onto a fine cable chain so it sits flush against the skin.

The plainest piece we make, and the easiest to wear. A bezel has no claws to catch on clothing, which makes this the one you put on and forget.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamond
  • Full bezel setting
  • Chain threaded through the setting
  • Nothing to catch on clothing
  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD201.title: 1.16 CTW Oval Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD201.description:

An oval-cut lab-grown diamond set upright within a close halo of round brilliants, suspended from a fine cable chain.

The halo widens the outline and gives the pendant presence at just over a carat. Worn vertically, it draws the eye down the neckline.

Key Features:

  • 1.16 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo

  • Lobster clasp fastening
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD202.title: 2 CTW Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Solitaire Pendant Necklace
AJPD202.description:
Description

A two-carat emerald-cut lab-grown diamond held in four corner claws beneath a plain tapered bail, with nothing else on the chain.

Emerald is the most architectural of the cuts — long open facets rather than scatter. At this size there is real depth to look into.

  • Four-claw corner setting
  • Plain tapered bail
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

An emerald-cut lab-grown diamond claw-set beneath a single round brilliant, the two stones stacked so the round sits where a bail would normally be.

  • Four-claw corner setting
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD236.title: 7.62 CTW Round & Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Toi et Moi Pendant Necklace
AJPD236.description:
Description

A large round brilliant lab-grown diamond beside an equally substantial emerald cut, each claw-set and hung from its own point on the chain so the pair sits level.

Our largest pendant by some distance — over seven and a half carats across two stones. The contrast between the round's fire and the emerald's long clear facets is the whole point of the piece.

  • 7.62 CTW total diamond weight
  • Two-stone toi et moi arrangement

  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD361.title: 0.5 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Bezel Pendant Necklace
AJPD361.description:

A half-carat round brilliant lab-grown diamond set in a smooth bezel, the chain threaded directly through the back so the pendant lies flat.

Understated to the point of being invisible under a collar, which is rather the point. The bezel protects the stone's edge, making this one to wear daily.

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamond
  • 0.5 CTW total diamond weight
  • Full bezel setting
  • Chain threaded through the setting
  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD370.title: 1.11 CTW Oval Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Cross Pendant Necklace
AJPD370.description:
Description

Five oval-cut lab-grown diamonds form the arms of a cross, meeting at a round brilliant at the centre. Each stone is claw-set individually, with the metal kept to a minimum.

The ovals give the cross a soft, open outline rather than a solid one. Just over a carat in total.

  • Round brilliant at the centre
  • 1.11 CTW total diamond weight
  • Individually claw-set
  • Fine cable chain

AJPD403.title: 1.35 CTW Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD403.description:

An emerald-cut lab-grown diamond set east-west inside a rectangular halo of round brilliants, with the chain running through the top of the frame.

Turning the emerald cut sideways makes it read wider across the collarbone, and the halo squares off the outline. The chain threads through the setting, so it sits flat.

  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD404.title: 1.41 CTW Oval Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD404.description:
Description

An oval-cut lab-grown diamond set east-west within a close halo of round brilliants, the chain passing through the top of the frame so the pendant lies flat.

Worn sideways the oval follows the collarbone rather than hanging from it. The halo lifts it to well over a carat of visible spread.

  • Oval-cut lab-grown centre diamond, set east-west
  • 1.41 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo

  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD408.title: 2 CTW Pear & Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Toi et Moi Pendant Necklace
AJPD408.description:
Description

A pear-cut lab-grown diamond set beside an emerald cut, each claw-set and suspended from its own point on the chain so the two hang side by side.

Two carats across two stones, and two quite different characters — the pear bright and curved, the emerald long and still. Toi et moi: one for each of you.

AJPD409.title: 1.16 CTW Emerald Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD409.description:
Description

An emerald-cut lab-grown diamond set east-west inside a rectangular halo of round brilliants, threaded onto a fine cable chain through the top of the frame.

The smaller of our emerald halo pendants, and the easier of the two to wear every day. Still wide enough across the collarbone to be noticed.

  • 1.16 CTW total diamond weight
  • Rectangular round brilliant halo
  • Chain threaded through the setting
  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD410.title: 1.17 CTW Heart Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD410.description:
Description

A heart-cut lab-grown diamond framed by a halo of round brilliants that traces the lobes and the point, with the chain running through the top of the setting.

The heart is the hardest cut to get right — the halo emphasises the symmetry rather than hiding it. Just over a carat all told.

  • 1.17 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo following the outline
  • Chain threaded through the setting
  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD411.title: 1.2 CTW Marquise Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD411.description:
Description

A marquise-cut lab-grown diamond set east-west, ringed by round brilliants that follow its pointed oval outline, with the chain passing through the top of the frame.

Worn sideways the marquise becomes a long horizontal line — the widest spread of any shape at this carat weight.

  • 1.2 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo
  • Chain threaded through the setting
  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD412.title: 1.19 CTW Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD412.description:
Description

A pear-cut lab-grown diamond set point upward within a close halo of round brilliants that follows the teardrop outline, the chain running through the top of the setting.

The halo widens the shoulders of the pear and sharpens its point. A classic drop shape, kept compact enough for daily wear.

  • 1.19 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo following the teardrop outline

AJPD413.title: 1.17 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Pendant Necklace
AJPD413.description:
Description

A round brilliant lab-grown diamond set within a ring of smaller rounds, the chain threaded through the top of the frame so the pendant sits flat against the skin.

The most straightforward of the halo pendants, and the one that suits everyone. Just over a carat, reading noticeably larger.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown centre diamond
  • 1.17 CTW total diamond weight
  • Round brilliant halo
  • Chain threaded through the setting
  • Lies flat against the skin
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

BR24435.title: Multi-Gemstone Station Bracelet in Gold
BR24435.descriptionHtml:
Description

Eleven emerald-cut gemstones sit in slim gold bezels along a fine cable chain, spaced so each stone catches the light on its own. Amethyst, garnet, peridot, citrine and blue topaz run through the design in a soft, repeating sequence.

Light enough to layer with a tennis bracelet or wear by itself, it finishes with a classic bolt-ring clasp. A quiet bit of colour for every day.

Key Features:

  • Amethyst, garnet, peridot, citrine and blue topaz
  • Fine cable chain with bolt-ring clasp

AJPD262.title: Engraved Initial Tag Pendant Necklace
AJPD262.description:
Description

A slim 12 × 6 mm rectangular tag hangs from a fine box chain, the initial engraved into its polished face so the letter shows in quiet relief.

Plain on purpose. It layers under everything and reads as a keepsake rather than a statement — the kind of piece that stays on.

Key Features:

  • Rectangular tag with engraved initial
  • 12 × 6 mm tag
  • High-polish finish
  • Fine box chain

AJPD263.title: 0.25 CTW Initial & Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Station Necklace
AJPD263.description:
Description

An initial sits off-centre on the chain, balanced by a single bezel-set round brilliant further along. Nothing is centred, which is what makes it look worn rather than arranged.

The asymmetry means it sits well layered with a longer piece — the letter falls at the collarbone, the diamond just past it.

Key Features:

  • Off-centre initial with a bezel-set round brilliant diamond

AJPD294.title: 4 CTW Oval, Emerald & Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Cluster Necklace
AJPD294.description:
Description

Three cuts gathered at an angle — an oval, an emerald and a pear — each claw-set at its own tilt so the cluster reads as scattered rather than symmetrical.

Three different silhouettes in one setting, which is what gives it movement. It catches light from several directions at once.

Key Features:

  • Oval, emerald and pear cut lab-grown diamonds
  • Three-stone angled cluster
  • Individually claw-set
  • Fine cable chain

AJPD295.title: 0.68 CTW Multi-Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Bar Necklace
AJPD295.description:
Description

Five cuts set in a line along a polished horizontal bar — oval, heart, round, emerald and marquise — each flush to the surface so the bar stays clean in profile.

A quiet way to show five silhouettes at once. It sits straight across the collarbone and stays put.

Key Features:

  • Oval, heart, round, emerald and marquise cut lab-grown diamonds
  • Polished horizontal bar
  • Five stones set in a row
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD405.title: 1.43 CTW Marquise Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Halo Station Necklace
AJPD405.description:
Description

A marquise-cut lab-grown diamond set on its side, ringed by a halo of pavé and hung east-west so it follows the line of the collarbone rather than pointing down it.

Two bezel-set rounds sit further along the chain on either side, so the piece keeps going past the centre stone instead of stopping at it.

Key Features:

  • Marquise cut centre stone with a pavé halo
  • 1.43 CTW total diamond weight
  • East-west setting
  • Two bezel-set diamond stations on the chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD439.title: 2.24 CTW Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Graduated Smile Necklace
AJPD439.description:
Description

Nine pear-cut lab-grown diamonds curve across the front of the chain, graduating from the largest at the outside to the smallest at the centre, points alternating up and down.

The curve follows the neckline on its own rather than needing to be arranged. It reads as a frontal necklace but sits as lightly as a chain.

Key Features:

  • Nine graduated pear cut lab-grown diamonds
  • Alternating point direction
  • Curved frontal setting
  • Fine cable chain

AJPD442.title: 3 CTW Heart Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Clover Pendant Necklace
AJPD442.description:

Three heart-cut lab-grown diamonds bezel-set point-to-point make a clover, finished with a slim polished stem that curls beneath.

The bezels do the work here — a continuous metal edge around each heart, so the leaf shape holds together as one form rather than three stones.

  • Three heart cut lab-grown diamonds
  • Full bezel settings
  • Polished stem detail
  • Fine cable chain

AJPD446.title: 0.48 CTW Pear Cut Green Gemstone & Lab-Grown Diamond Toi et Moi Necklace
AJPD446.description:
Description

A pear-cut green gemstone leans against a round brilliant lab-grown diamond, both claw-set and angled towards one another so they meet at the point.

The smallest of our toi et moi pieces, and the one that reads as colour first. It sits high and close to the collarbone.

Key Features:

  • Pear cut green gemstone with a round brilliant lab-grown diamond
  • Two-stone toi et moi arrangement
  • Individually claw-set and angled
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD447.title: 0.5 CTW Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Key Pendant Necklace
AJPD447.description:
Description

A pear-cut lab-grown diamond sits in the bow of a polished key, the stone held point-down where the loop closes.

The shaft and bit are left plain and highly polished, so the diamond is the only thing catching light on an otherwise solid form.

Key Features:

  • Pear cut lab-grown diamond set in the bow
  • High-polish key form
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD448.title: 0.18 CTW Marquise Cut Blue Gemstone Evil Eye Heart Pendant Necklace
AJPD448.description:
Description

A marquise-cut blue gemstone is bezel-set at the centre of a heart, surrounded by concentric engraved lines that ripple outwards to the edge.

The engraving is what carries it — line after line following the heart shape, so the eye at the centre sits in the middle of the ripple.

AJPD451.title: 2.04 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Cross Pendant Necklace

Description

Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds run the full length of both arms, claw-set end to end so no metal shows between them.

A classic proportion — the upright longer than the crossbar, the stones graduating slightly towards the ends.

AJPD455.description:
Description

A single round brilliant lab-grown diamond claw-set beneath a slim polished bail, hanging free on a fine cable chain.

Nothing around it and nothing behind it, so light passes straight through the stone. The piece everything else layers over.

Description

A marquise-cut lab-grown diamond held in a full bezel, the metal following the stone to its two points and finished flush.

The bezel makes it hard-wearing and keeps the outline clean — nothing to catch, nothing to snag.

Key Features:

  • Marquise cut lab-grown diamond

  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPD459.title: 0.44 CTW Pear & Round Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Cross Pendant Necklace
AJPD459.description:
Description

Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds run down the upright and across the bar, with a pear cut set at each of the three outer tips.

The pears turn the ends into points rather than stopping them square, which lengthens the whole cross.

Key Features:

  • Pavé round brilliant lab-grown diamonds
  • Pear cut lab-grown diamond at each tip
  • Open polished bail
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJPDP85.title: 4 CTW Pear Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Star Pendant Necklace
AJPDP85.description:
Description

Five pear-cut lab-grown diamonds radiate from a round brilliant at the centre, points outwards, forming a star that hangs from two points on the chain.

Because it is suspended at two points rather than one, it lies flat against the skin instead of turning.

Key Features:

  • Five pear cut lab-grown diamonds around a round brilliant centre
  • Star arrangement
  • Two-point suspension so it lies flat
  • Fine cable chain
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB96.title: Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Pavé Bangle Bracelet
AJLB96.description:
Description

A single row of round brilliant lab-grown diamonds runs along the face of a slim hinged bangle, claw-set edge to edge so no metal shows between them.

The hinge and concealed clasp mean it opens rather than slides, so it sits close without needing to clear the hand. Slim enough to stack, solid enough to wear alone.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds in a continuous row
  • Hinged bangle with a concealed box clasp
  • Slim profile, comfortable to stack
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB110.title: Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Station Bracelet
AJLB110.description:
Description

Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds sit in low round settings spaced along a fine cable chain, each one lifted just clear of the links.

The spacing is what makes it — the stones catch light one at a time as the wrist moves, rather than all at once. Light enough to forget you have it on.

Key Features:

  • Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, evenly spaced
  • Low settings on a fine cable chain
  • Bolt-ring clasp
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB220.title: Pink & White Lab-Grown Diamond Flower Station Bracelet
AJLB220.description:
Description

Five pink lab-grown diamonds form a flower around a white centre stone, set at the middle of a fine cable chain with single white diamonds spaced either side.

The pink sits against white metal rather than matching it, which is what makes the flower read from a distance. Delicate without being fussy.

Key Features:

  • Pink lab-grown diamond flower with a white centre
  • White lab-grown diamond stations along the chain
  • Fine cable chain with a bolt-ring clasp
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB228.title: Blue & White Lab-Grown Diamond Tennis Bracelet
AJLB228.description:
Description

Blue and white lab-grown diamonds alternate the whole way round, claw-set in a single unbroken line so the colour repeats at an even rhythm.

A tennis bracelet that does something other than sparkle uniformly. The blue reads clearly in daylight and darkens under warm light.

Key Features:

  • Alternating blue and white lab-grown diamonds
  • Continuous claw-set line
  • Box clasp with a safety catch
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB236.title: Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Solitaire Chain Bracelet
AJLB236.description:
Description

One round brilliant lab-grown diamond claw-set directly into a fine cable chain, sitting off-centre rather than in the middle.

The plainest thing we make, and the one that goes with everything. Meant to be layered, or worn on its own and barely noticed until it catches the light.

Key Features:

  • Single round brilliant lab-grown diamond
  • Set directly into the chain, off-centre
  • Fine cable chain with a bolt-ring clasp
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB68.title: 9 CTW Marquise Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Bezel Tennis Bracelet
AJLB68.description:
Description

Marquise-cut lab-grown diamonds set east-west in full bezels, each one following the stone to its two points so the line reads as a row of closed ovals rather than claws.

Nine carats laid flat against the wrist. The bezels make it hard-wearing — nothing to snag, nothing to catch on a sleeve.

Key Features:

  • Marquise cut lab-grown diamonds, bezel-set
  • 9 CTW total diamond weight
  • East-west setting along the full length
  • Box clasp with a safety catch
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB185.title: 1.07 CTW Round Brilliant Lab-Grown Diamond Micro Pavé Tennis Bracelet
AJLB185.description:
Description

A single line of tiny round brilliant lab-grown diamonds runs the whole way round on a wire so fine the metal nearly disappears behind it.

The lightest thing in the range, and the one that stacks with anything. It reads as a thread of light rather than a piece of jewellery.

Key Features:

  • Micro pavé round brilliant lab-grown diamonds
  • 1.07 CTW total diamond weight
  • Ultra-fine profile, built to stack
  • Box clasp
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options

AJLB187.title: 7.4 CTW Mixed Cut Lab-Grown Diamond Tennis Bracelet
AJLB187.description:
Description

Emerald, oval, marquise, pear and round lab-grown diamonds alternate around the bracelet, each set east-west so the shapes read one after another along the wrist.

No two neighbours are the same cut, which is what stops it looking like a standard tennis line. Every stone catches light at a slightly different angle.

Key Features:

  • Emerald, oval, marquise, pear and round cut lab-grown diamonds
  • 7.4 CTW total diamond weight
  • East-west settings in an alternating sequence
  • Box clasp with a safety catch
  • Available in white, yellow and rose metal options
